classifierProblem: Natural short-Event weak supervision remained severely label-skewed even after three-model consensus, providing almost no curiosity, annoyance, remorse, anger, or disgust supervision.
hypothesis: A taxonomy-balanced set of original short Event exemplars generated from all fixed Product-18 definitions, then accepted only when two blind validators independently recover the exact target, can strengthen underrepresented label semantics without changing thresholds or fitting RTN rows.
generalizationRationale: All 18 labels receive the same generation budget and fixed acceptance rule. No RTN text, prediction, mismatch, desired RTN count, COSO error, incumbent output, or external restricted text is used in generation or acceptance.

generation.requirements: original first-person private Event, English, 30-260 characters, no copied or paraphrased source, 0-2 Product-18 contract; single-label target must be central without requiring a second label

blindValidation.visibility: validators receive only rowId, text, Product-18 definitions, and the 0-2 output contract; target, generator identity, other validator, RTN, COSO, incumbent outputs, and desired counts are hidden
blindValidation.acceptance: both validators must independently return the exact target label set; uncertainty does not override mismatch

feasibilityGate.failure: DO_NOT_TRAIN; do not regenerate, relax acceptance, add an adjudicator, or change quotas

trainingSetIfFeasible.perLabel: first 12 accepted rows by frozen rowId for each of 18 labels
trainingSetIfFeasible.empty: first 72 accepted empty rows by frozen rowId

candidateTraining.updates: classifier head plus top two encoder layers only
candidateTraining.checkpointSelection: single final checkpoint; no sweep or interim COSO/RTN evaluation

evaluation.selector: unchanged threshold 0.35, fixed Product-18 order tie-break, maximum two
evaluation.RTN300: one frozen broad candidate-vs-incumbent comparison after candidate final
evaluation.correlationWarning: The synthetic generator/validators share model families with the RTN panel. RTN is therefore correlated research evidence, not independent validation or promotion evidence.

successCriteria.RTNResolved: micro-F1 >= 0.3313265306; exact-set >=50.41%; precision >=0.3341666667; recall >=0.2857142857; FP<=64; FN<=85; summed absolute 0/1/2 count error<=54
successCriteria.COSO149: micro-F1>=0.5180528053; macro-F1>=0.3351786297; FP<=60; FN<=87; no support>=5 label loses >0.08 F1
successCriteria.decision: RETAIN_FOR_RESEARCH only if every gate passes; otherwise REJECT

forbidden: loss, threshold, selector, seed, epoch, or LR sweep
